title: The Visitor of Vessel Farm
author: August Vane
blurb: Noor Sandoval, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must get the family out ahead of the count before the well refills.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
